# Awesome AI-Native

> A curated list of AI-native products and resources — where an LLM is the product, not a feature. 250+ tools across 40+ categories, for builders and practitioners.

## What is this?

Awesome AI-Native is an open-source reference list maintained by Samuel Berthe. It tracks products where a large language model is the core of the experience, not an "AI-powered" feature bolted onto a legacy tool. Entries are dropped once a product shuts down or pivots away from AI.

AI-native means the product would not exist without the model: the LLM is the interface, the engine, and the value. This list covers the full ecosystem — from consumer chat apps and coding agents to the models, compute, and developer tooling underneath them.

## Coverage

- **Chat & agents** — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Meta AI, general-purpose agents, self-hosted personal AI agents, computer-use models
- **Vibe-coding and vibe-engineering** — coding agents, code understanding and docs, app builders
- **Knowledge work** — AI search and research, knowledge management, meetings and voice
- **Industry applications** — customer support, sales and CRM, legal, healthcare, education
- **Creative & media** — design, image generation, video generation, audio and music
- **Models & robotics** — open-weight models, small language models, robotics and embodied AI, OCR
- **Compute & infrastructure** — AI chips and hardware, local inference, developer infrastructure, sandboxes
- **Developer tooling** — frameworks and SDKs, MCP and integrations, vector databases and retrieval, agent memory, evaluation and observability
- **Learning & community** — newsletters and blogs, podcasts, people to follow, courses, foundational papers, events, communities
